about_the_game:
Enter a glitched TV world where nothing is what it seems.

Story

You are David, a journalist whose reputation was shattered, costing him his career. Now working as a technician, you struggle to rebuild your life while searching for your missing son. One day, you discover a mysterious tape dated after his disappearance. When you play it, the TV screen pulls you inside, trapping you in the eerie and glitched world of Channel 51.

As you progress, you will encounter different channels and programs containing fragments of the story and clues about your son’s whereabouts. From retro sitcoms to post-apocalyptic worlds and haunted mansions, each channel drags you into a distinct narrative full of mystery and tension.

Gameplay & Mechanics

Armed only with a remote control, David can:

  • Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas and hidden secrets.

  • Change channels and jump between stories to uncover new clues.

  • Move objects, interact with codes, and activate mechanisms in the environment.

  • Turn the TV on or off to reveal the dark side of the channel, where the Dark Noise lurk, trying to absorb him.

The remote evolves as you progress: new buttons and functions appear as you unlock more areas, increasing complexity and strategy. You’ll need to hide and survive when the Dark Noise approach, using wit and stealth to continue your search.

Environments & Atmosphere

Each channel is a world of its own. Jump between them, solve puzzles, and unlock new functions of your remote control as you unravel the mystery behind Channel 51.

📡 Current Transmission of Channel 51

🕵️‍♀️ I Love Daisy (1950s American Sitcom)
Bright and black-and-white, with canned laughter and perfect sets… until glitching signals reveal that something dark lurks behind the façade.

🪆 Night of the Living Dolls (1980s Horror Movie)
A mansion shrouded in shadows, flickering lights, dolls that seem to come alive, and the creeping feeling that you are not alone.

☢️ Forbidden Zone (2000s Post-Apocalyptic Series)
A desolate wasteland marked by radiation, remnants of secret experiments, and clues that challenge your sanity.

Each environment is designed to generate tension and mystery, using lighting, sound, and glitches to create an immersive and disturbing experience.

Key Features

  • First-person psychological thriller

  • Dynamic puzzle-solving with the remote control

  • Channel-hopping and world-jumping to discover clues and advance the story

  • Dark beings that force stealth and strategic thinking

  • Varied environments: retro sitcoms, post-apocalyptic worlds, haunted mansions

  • Environmental and fragmented storytelling, where every detail matters

  • Dynamic lighting and sound design to intensify immersion and suspense

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Play with headphones for the best horror experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Play in a dark room with headphones for full immersion.

short_description: A first-person psychological horror thriller. Explore glitched channels, solve puzzles with your remote, and uncover clues about your missing son. Retro sitcoms, post-apocalyptic landscapes, and haunted mansions draw you into a tense, immersive narrative.
